Why Apply

More Than a Degree.
A Global Community.

Shaped by real-world needs, guided by global standards, and built on decades of international development expertise — TaiwanICDF offers more than a degree. Whatever your field, whatever your background, you are welcome here.

01
Zero Financial Barriers
Pursue a world-class undergraduate, master's, or Ph.D. degree at a renowned Taiwanese university — fully funded, so you can focus entirely on learning.
02
Real-World Programmes
Every course is carefully designed to tackle real development challenges, giving you practical, relevant knowledge you can apply from day one.
03
Global Professional Competence
All training is conducted in English, sharpening your international communication skills and preparing you for a borderless career.
04
A Community That Lasts
Join a diverse, mission-driven network of scholars, professors, and industry leaders from around the world — connections that go far beyond graduation.
05
A Future Reimagined
The experiences you gain in Taiwan will stay with you long after you return home — bringing back deeper confidence, new perspectives, and a clearer vision of who you want to become. Doors you never imagined will open, giving you the foundation to grow, contribute, and thrive — wherever life takes you next.
Scope of Scholarship

Everything Covered.
Nothing to Worry About.

From your first flight to your final exam, TaiwanICDF has you covered. Every essential is taken care of, so you can put your energy where it belongs: your studies, your growth, and your future.

Airfare
Round-trip Economy Class flights to and from Taiwan, arranged by TaiwanICDF.
Housing
On-campus dormitory accommodation throughout your entire programme.
Tuition & Credit Fees
Fully covered as required by your university, including all registered credit fees.
Insurance
Comprehensive accidental and medical coverage for the entire duration of your studies.
Textbooks
Course materials covered as required by instructors, subject to institutional approval.
Monthly Allowance
Deposited directly into your local bank account, every month, for the full programme period.
Monthly Living Allowance

Programmes Offered

Your Field.
Taiwan's Strength.
Your Advantage.

Shaped by real-world needs, guided by global standards, and built on decades of international development expertise — TaiwanICDF offers more than a degree.

The TaiwanICDF provides scholarships for higher education in cooperation with partner universities in Taiwan, at undergraduate, graduate and Ph.D. levels.

01
Engineering & Science
Home to TSMC and a world-leading tech ecosystem, Taiwan puts you at the centre of global innovation in semiconductors, ICT, and green energy — welcoming curious minds from every corner of the world.
Technology · Innovation
02
Public Health & Medicine
Ranked among the world's top healthcare systems, Taiwan is a living model of universal coverage and public health resilience — where diverse perspectives drive better solutions for everyone.
Healthcare · Resilience
03
Business & Management
At the crossroads of East-West trade and finance, Taiwan nurtures global thinkers from all cultures and backgrounds, giving you the mindset and network to lead in an interconnected world.
Finance · Leadership
04
Agriculture
A global leader in tropical agri-tech and food innovation, Taiwan brings together international expertise and local knowledge — because the best solutions grow from many roots.
Agri-Tech · Sustainability
05
Education
Rooted in academic excellence and open to the world, Taiwan prepares educators who understand that great teaching begins with embracing difference and empowering every learner.
Excellence · Empowerment
06
Others
Whatever your calling, wherever you come from — TaiwanICDF believes that diversity of thought, culture, and experience is the foundation of meaningful progress.
Diversity · Purpose
